config.permitted_interpretation: A match says this worktree reproduces the archived val-only numbers under the historical split. It does not create an untouched test set.
config.success_criterion: Every scheduled checkpoint finishes, and each compared column is within 0.001 absolute of the archived CSV. A larger difference is reported; it is not deleted and the tolerance is not edited afterward.

config.notes: Selection uses force_reversed fork medians and does not use a learned model. A one-state range check showed uint8 change saturating near 0.18 while pixel RMS kept scaling up to gain 3200, so the bins are pixel-RMS intervals with a raster-change cap. mpm_legacy is preferred for the low bin when it qualifies. Empty bins stay UNFILLED. Gain 3200 is inside the grid because gain 800 remained below the high pixel floor on that range check.
config.split_version_reason: Simulator forks only. No train, validation, or test episodes are scored, and no learned checkpoint is loaded.

config.notes: Open-loop schedules use the rest centroid and a time-only waveform. legacy_random resamples from the deformed state and is not selectable. fresh_pool_v2 on each 120-episode pool is train 96, validation 12, test 12. Test accuracy is stored and is not an input to selection.

config.showcase_rule: max rgb_128 affected-pixel fraction, then latest frame, high-excitation disk
